description: Run a raw SoQL query against any Kansas City, MO open-data resource (data.kcmo.org) by its Socrata id (8-char like "vsgj-uufz"). Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use kcmo_datasets to find a resource id, or kcmo_recent for the common ones.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: kcmo_query
